summary: Iter8 backend static-serve architecture verified. Backend now serves built React frontend at / with SPA fallback while preserving /api priority. All 9 new iter8 tests pass + 39/39 regression tests (iter5/6/7) pass. Emergent preview UI unaffected: login + /settings → Remote Access tab renders correctly with no TDZ regression and zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1480 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into modules (auth, settings, tunnel, scheduler, static-serve) for maintainability. Not a blocker for iter8.

SPA fallback uses `if full_path.startswith('api/')` — defensive belt-and-braces since api_router takes priority anyway, and it correctly returns JSON 404 instead of index.html for unmatched /api/* paths. Good.
Static mount at `/static` is fine for CRA build output. Note: any future top-level `/static/*` API route would conflict — unlikely but worth a comment in code.
The static-serve block is wrapped in try/except which logs a warning instead of crashing if frontend/build is missing — correct behavior for dev environments without a build.
test_credentials: admin@restaurant.com / admin123 (verified working on Emergent preview)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter8 verified: GET / -> index.html (HTML); /static/js/main.327c38ec.js -> JS; /dashboard, /some/deep/route -> SPA fallback (HTML); /api/auth/login GET -> JSON 404 with detail='API route not found'; /api/nonexistent -> JSON 404; POST /api/auth/login (valid) -> 200 with token; (invalid) -> 401. Backend log confirms 'Serving built frontend from: /app/frontend/build'. Build artifacts at /app/frontend/build/static/js/main.327c38ec.js and /static/css/main.fbbc806d.css. Emergent preview routing (/ -> port 3000 dev frontend; /api -> port 8001 backend) is unaffected. Windows .vbs/.bat scripts not testable in linux container — verified by code inspection only as instructed.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. One initial test assertion (expected 405 on GET /api/auth/login) was incorrect: the SPA fallback explicitly raises HTTPException(404, 'API route not found') for any unmatched /api/* path, which is the correct behavior. The contract that matters (API NOT swallowed by SPA, returns JSON not HTML) is satisfied. Test was updated to assert 4xx + JSON content-type instead.
